text: Threatened by their mother, teenage Gretel and her little brother Hansel [flee into the woods|trigger|running from trouble], where hunger and the scent of baked cake lead them to the hut of Holda, who [feeds them and lets them stay in exchange for work|archetypes|The Bad Host]. While Hansel learns to cut wood, Gretel suffers visions and nightmares, and Holda, sensing her gifts, begins [teaching her witchcraft and the use of flying ointment|threat|witchcraft and cursed things]. Then Hansel finds [a pentagram carved into a tree|images|holy and occult objects].
